name: Posted operating cash equals cumulative gross receipts at every checkpoint
title: SC-13-25-01 Posted operating cash equals cumulative gross receipts at every checkpoint
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the fixture timeline for sites "A" and "B" starts with 0.00 cash
When the receipts up to <date> are posted, including paid fees
Then the posted operating cash of Site A is <site_a> and of Site B is <site_b>
And accruals, occupancy changes and title transfers add no cash
